sections.heading: 1. General Policy
sections.content: Link2Builder strives to provide a smooth and transparent experience. Refunds are applicable only under specific conditions mentioned below.

sections.heading: 2. Free Services
list: Services such as free video calls with builders are non-chargeable
No refund is applicable for free services

sections.heading: 3. Paid Services
sections.content: For any paid services (e.g., premium listings, priority connections, or featured access):

subsections.heading: ✅ Eligible for Refund:
list: Payment made but service not delivered
Technical failure from Link2Builder side preventing service usage
Duplicate payment or incorrect charge

subsections.heading: ❌ Not Eligible for Refund:
list: Change of mind after service is delivered
Dissatisfaction with builder/project
No response or delay from builder
User fails to attend scheduled video call
Incorrect information provided by user

sections.heading: 4. Refund Timeline
list: Refund requests must be raised within 7 days of payment
Approved refunds will be processed within 7–10 business days
Refunds will be credited to the original payment method

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation Policy
list: Users can cancel a scheduled service before it starts
Once a service is initiated or completed, it is non-refundable

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Transactions
list: Link2Builder is not responsible for payments made directly to builders
Any such transactions are non-refundable through Link2Builder

sections.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
list: All refund disputes will be reviewed internally
Final decision rests with Link2Builder

sections.heading: 8. Contact for Refunds
list: link2builderhelp@gmail.com
